target.study: Viral Nucleosome-Like Particles Show Increased Dynamic Behavior and Altered Thermodynamic Stability
target.metadata_seen_before_freeze: README only: synchronized time-series of unwrapped status for 73 bp on Entry and Exit DNA, folders by protein type and DNA type, four replicate files per end visible from tree names

novel_candidate_question: Beyond a difference in marginal unwrapping magnitude, do viral nucleosome-like particles exhibit a reproducible dynamical coupling/asymmetry between Entry and Exit DNA ends that is absent or weaker in matched truncated-eukaryotic controls?

frozen_sampling.rows: first 1024 parseable data rows from each CSV; header rows ignored
frozen_sampling.reason: bounded deterministic window that can be retrieved/replayed without selecting visually favorable trajectory segments

frozen_parse.per_row: read numeric fields; if exactly 73 binary-like status fields exist use all 73; if one leading monotonically nondecreasing time/index field plus 73 binary-like fields exists, discard only the leading field; otherwise PARSE_FAIL
frozen_parse.binary_like: values exactly 0/1 or values whose two unique finite values can be mapped monotonically to 0/1 without using condition labels
frozen_parse.paired_series: entry and exit files with identical replicate suffix; truncate to common sampled length

frozen_statistic.transform: first differences dU_t = U_t - U_(t-1) to remove slow level/trend effects
frozen_statistic.per_replicate_coupling: Pearson correlation r between dU_entry and dU_exit over sampled common rows
frozen_statistic.candidate_signature: negative r means anti-coupled mirror breathing: increments of unwrapping at one end tend to accompany decrements at the other end

discovery: at least 3 of 4 viral-alpha replicate r values < 0
replication: at least 3 of 4 viral-widom replicate r values < 0
frozen_gate.exact_label_null: within each DNA panel separately, enumerate all C(8,4)=70 assignments of four observed replicate-r values to VIRAL vs CONTROL, preserving group sizes; one-sided p is fraction with median difference <= observed
frozen_gate.null_requirement: one-sided exact p <=0.05 in discovery and p<=0.05 in replication

first_break_extension.definition: on cumulative dU-entry/dU-exit correlation, earliest row >=128 at which r<=-0.10 and remains <=-0.10 for all checkpoints spaced every 128 rows through row 1024
first_break_extension.purpose: localize where directional coupling first becomes persistent; localization is descriptive until separately validated

causal_isolation_firewall.same_trajectory_entry_exit: shared latent dynamics means coupling is association within one simulated system, not independent evidence
causal_isolation_firewall.independence_unit: replicate trajectory, not individual frame/base pair
causal_isolation_firewall.selection_collider: no replicate may be dropped for having weak/no coupling after values are seen

promotion_logic.if_fail: retain negative result; no threshold tuning on these panels
promotion_logic.if_pass: candidate unreported dynamical observable requiring dedicated post-result prior-art search and transport to another independently authored viral dataset
promotion_logic.scientific_breakthrough: NOT YET even on full C034 PASS
